description: Call this when the user asks which coins are overbought or oversold, for a crypto RSI heatmap, multi-timeframe RSI, or one contract's RSI on 15m, 1h, 4h, 12h, 1d, 3d, 1w or 1M. Returns the live board for the top-400 Binance crypto perps by volume plus every TradFi perp, with overbought/oversold counts per interval. Filter by symbol or kind (crypto|tradfi), sort by an interval.
name: get_rsi_heatmap
title: RSI heatmap: Wilder RSI(14) on eight timeframes for the top-400 crypto perps and every TradFi perp
